name: Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares - Après le § 40 - Am 92
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 20f. Regrets the fact that, despite Parliament’s call for an increase in directly managed support for the protection of the environment and biodiversity and climate action, building on the current LIFE programme, the Commission did not propose to continue the LIFE programme which, since 1992, has been the cornerstone of EU funding for the climate and the environment; calls for LIFE to be reinstated as a stand-alone programme as part of the 2028-2034 MFF;
